scope: Proposition 2.9 of the manuscript “Finite Smith–Toda Complexes at Varying Primes” (preprints/Finite-Smith-Toda-Complexes-at-Varying-Primes-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 308 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13dce3978089a78f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix 0 ≤ r ≤ n. Suppose cycles bh of chain degree zero and weight wh, for 0 ≤ h ≤ r, have been chosen successively in the strict algebras A[e0, . . . , ej−1], |eh|chain = 1, wt(eh) = wh, ∂eh = bh ∈ A[e0, . . . , eh−1], b0 = ϖu0. (2.7) For 0 ≤ j ≤ r + 1, these algebras determine commutative algebras Yj ∈ C, with Y0 = 1. For 0 ≤ j ≤ r, the cycle bj represents a map S(wj) → Yj, and there is a cofiber sequence S(wj) ⊗ Yj bj·− − − − → Yj −→ Yj+1, (2.8) whose second map is the algebra map adjoining the null ej. For M = [(MU(p))p] and 0 ≤ j ≤ r+1, there are compatible equivalences hΩ(M ⊗ Yj) ≃ hΩ(M) ⊗A A[e0, . . . , ej−1]. (2.9)
